articles.summary: QHexRT is live: an inference engine built to run LLM, VLM, STT, TTS and embeddings entirely on Qualcomm Hexagon NPUs. The first model, LFM 2.5 230M, reaches 12,540 tok/s prefill and a flat 36 ms TTFT on v81.
articles.title: QHexRT Is Live: Full-Stack NPU Inference for Qualcomm Hexagon
